info.title: Crehler Payment Bundle - Customer Sub-Method Selection
info.description: Store API endpoint for reading the customer's selected payment sub-method (e.g. which bank they chose for online transfer). Setting the sub-method is done through the standard context switch (PATCH /store-api/context with a `paymentSubMethod` field) — mirroring the native paymentMethodId. There is no dedicated write endpoint.

get.description: Returns the customer's currently selected payment sub-method. Resolved from the session first, then from the customer's account (logged-in or guest). Used to pre-select the previously chosen bank or e-wallet in the UI.

403.description: No customer context (neither logged-in nor guest)

subPaymentMethodId.description: Provider-specific identifier of the selected sub-method (e.g. bank ID). Null if no sub-method has been selected.
